1977. Undo Operation in a Text Editor

50

Medium

Problem Statement

A text editor stores actions using a stack. Given a sequence of actions, determine the last action remaining after one Undo operation.

Description

The latest action is stored on top of the stack. Remove the most recent action and display the new top action.

If no action remains, print "Nothing To Undo".
